title: FLA binary import: AS2 className not decoded from CPicPage afterData
description: DONE — className was already decoded as part of task 0874 (commit 3f979de). flash8-binary.ts reads className from the writeAsLinkage block in the Contents stream (s.end+41 offset, BomString sequence: linkageIdentifier, linkageURL, className). Fla8SymbolInfo.className is forwarded to SymbolLinkage.className via createSymbolLinkage() in flash8-import.ts line 1309. Three unit tests cover this in flash8-import.test.ts (lines 1355-1385). The CLAUDE.md note that 'className is NOT in the Contents stream' was written before 0874 was filed; it lives in the writeAsLinkage block of the Contents stream, not CPicPage afterData.
